categories.main_business_segments: Risen Energy primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of solar photovoltaic (PV) cells and modules. The company also operates in photovoltaic power station EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), power station operation, and energy storage systems. Additionally, it is involved in upstream polysilicon and silicon wafer manufacturing and downstream solar power applications, including BIPV (Building Integrated Photovoltaics) and LED lighting products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced N-type solar cell technologies such as Heterojunction with Intrinsic Thin-layer (HJT), TOPCon, and other high-efficiency crystalline silicon cell technologies. It employs proprietary technologies including ultra-thin 210mm wafers, low silver consumption metallization, and stress-free cell interconnection. Risen Energy integrates intelligent manufacturing with automation, digitalization, and data-driven process optimization to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Risen Energy serves global customers across approximately 90 countries and regions, including major markets in China, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. Its customers include solar power plant developers, commercial and residential rooftop users, and energy storage system integrators. The company targets industrial, commercial, and residential sectors with its PV modules and integrated energy solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in China (Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Inner Mongolia), Malaysia, and Vietnam, supporting its global sales network. It has established marketing and service centers in Europe, North and South America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. This global footprint enables it to mitigate trade barriers and serve diverse international markets effectively.
categories.supply_chain_position: Risen Energy operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic industry chain, focusing on solar cell and module manufacturing. It also extends upstream into polysilicon and wafer production and downstream into PV power station development, EPC services, and energy storage integration, achieving a vertically integrated supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-efficiency N-type solar cell technologies, especially HJT and related advanced modules, aiming to improve conversion efficiency and reduce levelized cost of electricity (LCOE). It emphasizes innovation in low-carbon manufacturing, intelligent production, and energy storage solutions. Risen Energy also explores emerging technologies like perovskite solar cells and smart PV system integration to expand application scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Risen Energy generates revenue mainly through the sale of solar cells and modules, EPC contracts for photovoltaic power stations, electricity sales from owned PV power plants, and sales of energy storage systems and related products. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Its revenue is derived from both domestic and international markets, with direct sales and distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Risen Energy is positioned as a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, particularly in high-efficiency N-type cell and module manufacturing. It competes with other major global PV manufacturers and benefits from strong technological capabilities, scale, and vertical integration. The company is recognized among the top-tier PV module suppliers worldwide and holds significant market share in China and overseas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Risen Energy reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 20.24 billion, a decline of 42.71% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.44 billion. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 43.09 billion with net assets of RMB 11.5 billion. Despite short-term profit declines due to market price pressures and asset impairments, the company maintains substantial production capacity (40GW annual module capacity) and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Risen Energy emphasizes its advanced N-type heterojunction technology, ultra-thin large-size wafers, and low silver consumption to deliver high-efficiency, low-carbon photovoltaic products with superior power output and reliability. Its vertically integrated supply chain and intelligent manufacturing enable cost control and quality assurance. The company’s global presence and comprehensive energy solutions, including integrated storage and BIPV products, provide differentiated value to customers seeking high-performance and sustainable solar energy solutions.
